summary: Iteration 74: Validated 3-tier pricing restructure (Leadership OS €997 / OS PLUS €4.447 / Enterprise quote-based) + new Downloads PDF page. Backend = 17/17 tests passing on new test_iteration74_pricing.py. Frontend = 3 tier cards + installment modal with both plans + all 4 download cards + Sidebar 'Downloads (PDF)' link all rendering. Enterprise quote+lead endpoints verified end-to-end via backend. Enterprise modal UI flow blocked in Playwright by recurring SmartPopup (WladBot 'incoming call' overlay) — modal element exists & opens on direct CTA click but popup re-intercepts; main agent should verify in real browser or set a flag to suppress popup on /coaching.

minor.issue: Admin notification email — ENTERPRISE_LEAD_EMAIL env NOT set; falls back to SENDER_EMAIL (reminders@leader-os.de). Works but consider explicit ENTERPRISE_LEAD_EMAIL for routing leads to sales inbox.
Brute-force rate limit (429) trips quickly during regression-test runs (test_iteration68_auth_enterprise.py first failure). Pre-existing — not introduced this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: SmartPopup 'WladBot - Bereit für dein nächstes Leadership-Level?' overlay re-appears after dismissal and intercepts clicks on tier-cta-enterprise; in Playwright we could not reach enterprise-quote-modal on /coaching. The CTA element is present and visible (data-testid=tier-cta-enterprise found). Recommend: suppress SmartPopup auto-trigger while on /coaching, or scope it to /dashboard only.

rca of the issue: Enterprise modal UI block: the global SmartPopup (KI-Coach incoming call) auto-triggers on route changes and renders as a fixed-position overlay covering the viewport. Clicking 'Ablehnen' dismisses it but it re-fires after a few seconds, creating a race condition with the enterprise CTA click. Mitigation: (a) gate the SmartPopup to non-coaching routes, (b) add a 'dismissed_at' session flag that suppresses re-trigger for N minutes, or (c) expose a data-testid on the popup with a stable dismiss button so automation can deterministically clear it.
